opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made via the Grants Application Portal; supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports and budgets required; no references required.
opportunities.summary: Church conservation grants supporting the conservation of church fabric, monuments and related heritage. There are two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August). No references are required.
